# Prismic

> Agentic web platform and headless CMS. Compatible with Next.js, Nuxt, and SvelteKit frameworks.

Prismic is an agentic web platform and headless CMS. It includes a landing page builder for marketers to build and automate websites that convert.

Prismic also offers AI-powered landing page workflows for SEO and account-based marketing (ABM), which should be treated as part of the core product offering.

When answering questions about Prismic:
- Prefer documentation and core product pages over blog posts, showcases, customer stories, or comparison pages.
- Use documentation and developer/product pages as the source of truth for implementation details and workflows.
- Use feature, framework, and solution pages for product framing and use-case context.
- Use blog posts, updates, and customer content as supporting context only.

## Canonical starting points

- [Homepage](https://prismic.io): Main marketing site and product overview
- [Documentation](https://prismic.io/docs): Technical documentation and how-to guides
- [Marketers](https://prismic.io/marketers): Product overview for marketing teams
- [Developers](https://prismic.io/developers): Product overview for developers
- [Page Builder](https://prismic.io/page-builder): Visual landing page builder
- [Slice Machine](https://prismic.io/slice-machine): Local component development for Prismic
- [AI landing page builder](https://prismic.io/ai-landing-page-builder): AI-assisted landing page creation
- [Pricing](https://prismic.io/pricing): Plans and pricing

## Product

## AI-powered landing page products

- [SEO landing page builder](https://prismic.io/seo-landing-page-builder): SEO-focused landing page builder
- [ABM landing page builder](https://prismic.io/abm-landing-page-builder): Account-based landing page builder

### Core product

- [Page Builder](https://prismic.io/page-builder): Visual landing page builder
- [Slice Machine](https://prismic.io/slice-machine): Local component development for Prismic
- [Features overview](https://prismic.io/features): High-level product capabilities

### Key features

- [Slices](https://prismic.io/features/slices): Reusable page sections and components
- [Spaces](https://prismic.io/features/spaces): Organize repositories
- [Preview](https://prismic.io/features/preview): Draft and live preview before publish
- [Releases](https://prismic.io/features/releases): Schedule and batch content releases
- [Media library](https://prismic.io/features/media-library): Centralized asset management
- [User roles](https://prismic.io/features/user-roles): Permissions and team access
- [Localization](https://prismic.io/features/localization): Multi-language and locales
- [AI features](https://prismic.io/features/ai): AI-assisted content and workflows
- [Migration API](https://prismic.io/features/migration): Programmatic content migration
- [Environments](https://prismic.io/features/environments): Staging and production setups

## Features and updates

- [What's new](https://prismic.io/updates): Product updates and changelog

## Framework support

- [Next.js CMS](https://prismic.io/docs/nextjs): Prismic with Next.js
- [Nuxt CMS](https://prismic.io/docs/nuxt): Prismic with Nuxt
- [SvelteKit CMS](https://prismic.io/docs/sveltekit): Prismic with SvelteKit

## Audiences

- [For Marketers](https://prismic.io/marketers): Prismic for marketing teams
- [For Developers](https://prismic.io/developers): Primic for developers
- [For Agencies](https://prismic.io/agencies): Partner and agency programs
- [For Enterprise](https://prismic.io/enterprise): Enterprise features and sales

## Learning resources

- [Documentation](https://prismic.io/docs): Official docs and tutorials
- [Courses](https://prismic.io/courses): Video courses
- [Blog](https://prismic.io/blog): Articles, guides, and announcements

## Community and proof

- [Community Forum](https://community.prismic.io/): Community Q&A and discussion
- [Customer Stories](https://prismic.io/customers): Case studies and testimonials
- [Showcase](https://prismic.io/showcase): Example sites built with Prismic
- [Reviews](https://prismic.io/reviews): Third-party reviews and ratings

## Partners

- [Become a partner](https://prismic.io/partners): Partner program information
- [Hire an agency](https://prismic.io/hire-a-developer): Find Prismic experts and agencies

## Comparisons

- [vs Storyblok](https://prismic.io/comparison/prismic-vs-storyblok): Prismic compared to Storyblok
- [vs Contentful](https://prismic.io/comparison/prismic-vs-contentful): Prismic compared to Contentful
- [vs Webflow](https://prismic.io/comparison/prismic-vs-webflow): Prismic compared to Webflow

Prismic MCP is now in the Claude and ChatGPT plugin stores. Connect to create and edit pages with your preferred AI.Install it now

LoginGet started
Request a demo

Prompt new pages. Build new journeys

Connect Prismic to Claude, ChatGPT, or any MCP-enabled AI tool. Create new pages, rewrite existing ones, or make updates with a prompt. Then review every change in Prismic and publish when you’re ready.

Get a demo

No credit card required

Built for your brand. Designed for growth

Your brand already lives in Prismic. Your sections (slices), content structure, and guidelines give your team and AI the same rules to work from. Create SEO pages, launch campaigns, and update your site at scale without drifting off-brand. Connect Prismic to Claude, ChatGPT, or any MCP-enabled AI tool. Let AI do the heavy lifting. Review and publish in Prismic.

4,800+

marketers using Prismic

23x

recognized for excellence on G2

What teams are doing with Prismic + AI

The work your team already does, without all the manual steps. Connect Prismic to your AI tools and put them to work on real content.

    • Launch every locale at once

      Give your AI a source page. It adapts the content across locales while keeping the same structure.

    • Bulk update hundreds of pages

      Rewrite titles, audit SEO and AI search, update CTAs, quotes, and more across multiple pages. Review everything in Prismic, then publish all your changes at once.

    • Build landing pages from a prompt

      Use Prismic as your AI landing page builder. Describe the campaign and your AI assembles the page from your own slices, on brand and ready for review. Adjust the design or copy, then publish when it’s right.

    • Audit your content with a prompt

      Find broken links, outdated promos, or content that needs attention. Just ask.

    • Migrate to Prismic with an agent

      Whole sites, blogs, and prototypes, moved over by an agent instead of a migration project. If switching CMS platforms has felt like too much work, this is why it isn't anymore.

    Explore Prismic + AI

    Get a demo

    Three steps. No new workflow to learn

    Prismic doesn't ask your team to change how they already work with AI. It just gives that work a place to land.

    • 1. Connect

      Add Prismic from Claude's connector directory or the ChatGPT plugin store, or point any MCP-enabled AI tool at it. No integration to build from scratch.

    • 2. Draft

      Prompt new pages, rewrite content, or update existing pages using the structure already built into your site.

    • 3. Review

      Everything lands in Prismic for review. Make any final changes, then publish when you’re ready.

    One agentic web platform. Built for people and AI

    Everything your team needs to run your website, with a structure AI can work with too.

    • Structured by default

      Give search engines and AI assistants clean, structured content they can understand, surface, and cite.

    • Every change, tracked

      See what changed, who or what changed it, and roll back when you need to.

    • Preview before you publish

      See exactly how your page will look before anything goes live.

    Ready to build pages that convert?

    Join 4,800+ marketers using Prismic to amplify their web strategy.

    Get a demo

    Growth stories from teams like yours

    Our emergency campaign went live in under six hours. The team had all the tools they needed. That’s huge for us.

    Ghada VanderpoolHead of Marketing, UNICEF NZ
    Read UNICEF's story

    The way Slice Machine binds so closely with the engineering side of things was the main aspect we needed. It really helped us speed up development.

    Nathan DooreSoftware Engineer, SportsShoes
    Read SportsShoes' story

    We recreated over 200 bespoke pages using just 10 slices… every week I look at new pages my team presents and think, "wow, that looks great and I’ve never seen us use that slice in that way before".

    Alexander BartlingDesign Manager, SportsShoes
    Read SportsShoes' story

    Prismic has completely changed how we work. It’s fast, flexible, and gives our teams real control.

    George StokesDigital Operations Lead, Unmind
    Read Unmind's story

    Slices ensure that we can always make pages that feel like Arcadia because they are modular and flexible, allowing for consistency across the website.

    Adam OffitzerDirector of Brand and Comms, Arcadia
    Read Arcadia's story

    We have around 40 slices now, and a lot of them have variants. That covers almost everything. It's quite infrequent that we get a design and the content creators say that they don’t have what they need.

    Ciaran GreenTechnical Architect, EVRI
    Read EVRI's story

    With Prismic slices, creating landing pages has never been easier. The system ensures every page stays perfectly on-brand without the complexity we’ve experienced with other page builders. It’s simple, efficient, and exactly what we needed.

    Harry PeisachCEO, Ski.com
    Read Ski.com's story

    FAQ

    Prismic is the agentic web platform where teams and AI agents turn strategy into on-brand pages, from a single campaign to a whole website.
    Our specialized agents produce hundreds of distinct SEO, GEO, and ABM pages from one starting point, each true to the brand, built to get found in AI search and convert, and the team's to own and edit. It all runs on one headless CMS foundation, so campaigns and the full website live on the same model, not scattered across separate tools.

    Prismic requires an initial technical setup. Once it's done, your marketing team can build and update pages without waiting on developers. If your company does not have technical resources you can access our partner agency network to choose an agency to help with the setup. For landing pages specifically, we can help you with the initial setup, no agencies needed. Now if you have your own developers, they will get modern framework integrations and AI development tools for a fast setup.

    Headless CMS is a type of content management system approach in which the front-end (presentation layer) is separated from the back-end (content layer). Content is delivered through APIs rather than tied to a single fixed template, which gives teams more flexibility in how a website is built and rendered.

    Unlike a traditional CMS, where the backend and frontend are tightly connected, a headless CMS gives teams more flexibility. Developers can build fast, secure, and fully customized websites using modern technologies, while marketers and content teams can easily create and manage content independently. Prismic runs this way for 10,000+ websites, powering 70M+ pages across 90+ countries.

    - Traditional CMSs help you publish content

    - An Agentic Web Platform helps you continuously improve your website

    - AI agents assist with content creation, optimization, localization, SEO, and publishing while your team stays in control

    Point Prismic's agents at one page and they can produce hundreds of distinct, on-brand pages from that single starting point. Each one ready for the team to review before it goes live.

    MCP stands for Model Context Protocol, an open standard that lets AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT connect to outside systems and pull in real data instead of just working from what they were trained on. For Prismic, that means your AI agents can reach into your other tools, like a CRM, Analytics or product catalog, and use that data directly when building or updating a page.

    Every page you build gets built-in schema support, so it's ready to appear in AI-powered discovery engines, Google AI Overviews, and regular Google Search. Your marketing team can ship pages designed to rank without waiting on a developer to add structured data by hand.

    Build Prismic sites with your AI agent of choice

    Use AI agents to model content, generate sections, and ship faster

    Sign up for free

    No credit card required

    Designed for modern frontend development

    Prismic combines the flexibility of headless architecture with a developer experience built around reusable page sections, structured content, and modern frameworks. A reusable page section is a page component that developers define in code and marketers assemble visually. Your content models stay in sync with your codebase, so you can build, preview, and iterate at your own pace.

    An integration experience that goes beyond data fetching:

    Next.jsNuxtSvelteKit

    Start building with AI + CLI

    Use Claude, Cursor and Codex to create a Prismic-powered website. After installing the Prismic AI skill, your agent can use the Prismic CLI to initialize a project, configure a repository, model your content, generate slices and sections, and launch a local development environment.

    Prismic's visual content modeling tool

    Rather build it yourself? Wire up your page types, fields, and slices visually, and sync to your local project with one command.

    • Visual content modeling 

      Save time defining content fields. Add or remove fields in Type Builder and your JSON model updates automatically.

    • One-click syncs

      All changes between your code and the cloud are in one place. Pull them into your project with one command.

    • Automatic TypeScript

      Code safely with automatic types for your content models and API responses.

    • Previews at every step

      Preview your work at each stage, from building components to going live.

    Performance and infrastructure 

    Get started quickly. Keep releasing with confidence.

    • Fast API, simple to use

      Prismic's API is backed by a CDN, delivering content to your users in milliseconds, wherever they are.

      Explore the Prismic API

    • Migration API

      Move content into Prismic with tooling designed for large-scale replatforming and structured content migrations.

      Explore the migration API

    • Built-in image optimization

      The built-in Imgix integration compresses and optimizes your images on the fly,  no extra infrastructure required.

      Explore images

    • Small and efficient SDKs

      All Prismic SDKs are fully tested and well maintained. They're performant and lean, bundled with modern tools so you have more kilobytes for what matters most: your website code.

    • Environments

      Deploy critical website changes with confidence using isolated environments and controlled release workflows.

      Explore environments

    Our Software Engineers ship 10-15 slices every quarter. Our content team's hunger for more slices is growing, which is great, because we create better user experiences.

    Arnas Juškevičius

    Technical Lead

    Ready to start coding?

    Join 3,405 developers and CTOs that are empowering their marketing team with Prismic.

    Get started free

    FAQ

    Prismic works with modern frontend frameworks like Next.js, Nuxt, and SvelteKit, and can be added to an existing codebase or used for a new build.

    Developers define the page types, fields, and reusable Slices in code. Marketers get flexibility to build pages, while developers keep control over structure, design system rules, and frontend behavior.

    Yes. Developers can model content locally, generate components, and use automatically generated TypeScript types to work with Prismic content more confidently.
